claim: For a selfadjoint linear map Phi with Phi^2 EB, Psi=Phi^2 satisfies I-Psi <= 2(I-Phi); this is an exact Hilbert-space identity and does not require selfcompatibility.
scope: Provides EB rounding only on classes with a proven finite EB power; no bounded power-index consequence for arbitrary selfcompatible channels was found.
